# Apex-authored material availability baseline for the P2CE 512-VMF corpus.
# 209 unique side materials; 193 resolve to a shader and an on-disk base VTF.
# 13 missing VMTs: optional/custom content (anim_wp, bee2, pbr), older metal
# variants, and toolsinvisibleladder. These are content gaps, not parser errors.
# _rt_camera is a runtime render target. Refract and Water intentionally use
# shader-specific inputs instead of $basetexture; all three use the placeholder
# until their rendering features are implemented. No proprietary files copied.
